name: Shelly Plus 1PM UL
summary: Gen2 UL 1-channel 16A in-wall relay with power metering, Wi-Fi/BLE, AC or 24-30VDC powered.

extra.kb_note: KB page is generic Plus 1PM (EU model SNSW-001P16EU); UL rating may differ from 16A
extra.bridging_warning: don't use L/N terminals as bridges above 16A total

gotchas: Out of stock; previous-gen (Gen2) — see Shelly 1PM Gen4 for Zigbee/Matter
Terminals take only 20-16 AWG — 14/12 AWG house wire needs pigtails
Neutral required; output is switched line, not dry contact — see Shelly 1 Gen4 for dry contact
No Zigbee or Matter; Wi-Fi + BLE only
KB specs are from the EU Plus 1PM (16A); confirm the UL amp rating on the label
best_for: Metered on/off of a light or appliance with a UL-listed relay and Add-on sensor port
